candidates.snippet: 1682: Became Tsar of Russia - Peter I became Tsar of Russia, co-ruling with his half-brother Ivan V. 1703: Founded St. Petersburg - Peter the Great founded the city of St. Petersburg, which would become Russia's new capital. 1724: Established the Russian Academy of Sciences - Peter the Great established the Imperial Russian Academy of Sciences to promote learning and research. 1725: Died - Peter the Great died in St. Petersburg at the age of 52.
